title: Pubnet Soroban call whose return value is an SCV_STRING
why: SorobanTransactionMeta.returnValue can be any SCVal; an SCV_STRING return is bytes, not guaranteed UTF-8, and is rarer than the integer, address and void returns readers are tested on. A reader that maps return values only for the common arms, or decodes strings as text without checking, mishandles it.
notes: Chosen with the locate index of the full pubnet scan (token `S|site|meta.v4.sorobanMeta.returnValue:SCVal{SCV_STRING}d=1n=1`): among the ledgers that hold the shape, the one with the smallest lake object. Header hash recomputed from the header and every transaction hash recomputed from its envelope at capture. `expect.values` are written by hand from the decoded sidecar; participants, state changes and movements are the reference extractor's output, checked against the sidecar.

values.note: The call returns its first argument.
